catalogMeta.label: Make a Word (open build)
catalogMeta.description: Open build: put a letter from a bank in each of three boxes to MAKE any real CVC word that fits the ask (the short a sound in the middle; rhymes with cat), then press done; some items ask for a second word. Many words pass. Code checks the vowel, the family and the shape; the shared word judge checks it is a real word. K-2, scoped to the letter group. β = spell_word + 0.1.
